newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk bond yields firm on July inflation data.
newsitem.headline: Turk bond yields firm on July inflation data.

text.p: 1000 GMT - Turkish bond yields firmed 0.5 percentage point to around 116.5 pct in the most active papers on higher than expected July consumer price inflation. * Lira dived to 161,870 per dollar from Friday's 160,290 close on strong dollar/mark. * Avrg o/n money and o/n repo rates remain high at 73.75 and 79.57 pct, respectively amid cash shortage as market opened 13.7 trln lira short. * Treasury to auction 357-day bills on Tuesday with Wednesday settlement.
